priority_order.1: Combined upload requirement enforcement - REJECT incomplete uploads immediately
priority_order.2: UUID orphaning detection - Identify records without production matches
priority_order.3: Cross-file relationship consistency - Validate Campaign/Performance relationships
priority_order.4: Impression decrease detection - Flag any impression decreases as suspicious
priority_order.5: Deal name exact matching enforcement - NEVER accept Deal name changes
priority_order.6: Date change inconsistency flagging - Flag ALL date modifications
priority_order.7: Hierarchical name structure validation - Validate ' > ' structure parsing
priority_order.8: Mutual exclusion rule violations - Flag Campaign & Deal ID conflicts
priority_order.9: New entry business rule validation - Validate new records against business rules

business_rules.implementation_rule: When multiple violations apply to the same record, apply the highest priority rule for classification and include all violations in the violation reasons list

core_requirements: 100% of uploaded records receive exactly one classification
Combined upload requirement - reject incomplete file pairs
New entries properly validated against business rules
Updated entries track specific field changes with before/after preservation
Unchanged records identified and counted but excluded from approval workflow
Inconsistent data flagged with specific violation reasons for user review
business_rule_enforcement: Deal name changes never accepted (exact string matching)
Impression increases >0 classified as reasonable updates
Date changes flagged as inconsistent for future rule derivation
Only complete Campaign + Performance uploads accepted
Inconsistent classification trumps all other classifications
performance_and_quality: Classification performance handles full file volumes (7,000+ campaigns, 1,000+ performance records)
Production database queries acceptable for comparison (read-only impact)
All classification results stored in extended staging database
Comprehensive test coverage with all edge cases handled gracefully
